description: Rete GNSS is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by serviziogc.regione.fvg.it. Localisation of the permanent GNSS master stations constituting the GNSS network implemented by the Autonomous Region Friuli Venezia Giulia and active since 25/10/2012. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GIS digital system, automatic detection, geodesy, open data, infoFeatureAccessService, data base. The listing shows 2016-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
